
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/DashVector/p/19674476" title="发布于 2026-03-05 17:59">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">通义深度搜索-API概览</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>本产品（<a href="https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2ty02.31808181.d_app-market.1.6c4974a1tFmoFc&amp;tab=app#/app/app-market/deep-search/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><strong>通义深度搜索</strong></a>）对外服务接口目录。所有接口使用&nbsp;DashScope&nbsp;HTTP&nbsp;协议对外提供服务。</p>
<h2 id="api鉴权">API鉴权</h2>
<p>调用接口需要先<a href="https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/get-api-key" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">获取&nbsp;API&nbsp;Key</a>，邀测期间，仅百炼<strong>默认业务空间</strong>所属的API&nbsp;Key有调用权限。</p>
<h2 id="api目录">API目录</h2>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th><strong>API名称</strong></th>
<th><strong>API概述</strong></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><a href="https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/deepsearch-chat-generate" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">生成对话</a></td>
<td>基于智能体应用管理提供的&nbsp;agent_id&nbsp;与&nbsp;agent_version&nbsp;信息，提供场景化对话、研究、写作相关能力。</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><a href="https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/deepsearch-file-upload" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">上传文件</a></td>
<td>基于动态文件操作接口能力获取处理好的文件信息，支持智能体应用的&nbsp;API&nbsp;调用通过&nbsp;parameters.agent_options.sessions_files&nbsp;参数完成“动态文档解析”工具的文件数据注入。</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><a href="https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/deepsearch-report-export" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">生成报告导出</a></td>
<td>深度搜索应用生成的结果报告文件&nbsp;(md、html、pdf)&nbsp;获取。</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><a href="https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/docking-self-built-database" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">对接自有知识库</a></td>
<td>支持接入自有知识库，用户可以参考该接口规范进行知识库对接。</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<hr>
<p><a href="https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2ty02.31808181.d_app-market.1.6c4974a1tFmoFc&amp;tab=app#/app/app-market/deep-search/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">面向深度的查询问答和调研分析需求场景,多步骤推理规划研究路径,生成有洞察、可溯源、图文并茂的长文报告-大模型服务平台百炼(Model&nbsp;Studio)-阿里云帮助中心</a></p>
<p>欢迎加入讨论钉钉群，在这里您可以与其他用户进行深入交流，分享使用经验或获取更多技术支持，群号102415041551。</p>


</div>
